## What is MCP?

@@L0@@ is an open protocol that enables AI models to securely interact with local and remote resources through standardized server implementations. This list focuses on production-ready and experimental MCP servers that extend AI capabilities through file access, database connections, API integrations, and other contextual services.

* 🪟 – For Windows

> [!NOTE]
> Confused about Local 🏠 vs Cloud ☁️?
> * Use local when MCP server is talking to a locally installed software, e.g. taking control over Chrome browser.
> * Use cloud when MCP server is talking to remote APIs, e.g. weather API.
